sloka: कौम्भकर्णिस् ततो वीरो निकुम्भो नाम वीर्यवान् ।अब्रवीत् परम कुर्द्धो रावणम् लोक रावणम् ॥६-८-१९॥।।
transliteration: kaumbhakarṇis tato vīro nikumbho nāma vīryavān ।abravīt parama kurddho rāvaṇam loka rāvaṇam ॥6-8-19॥।।

translations.english: Thereafter the enraged heroic and valiant son of Kumbhakarna called Nikumbha said to Ravana, who made the world cry.
